                                        Figure 1. The core advantages of OctoT2I in performance, decision-making, and knowledge acquisition. (a) OctoT2I (Ours) achieves
                                        an exceptional performance-efficiency balance on GenEval. (b) This superior performance stems from its intelligent, evidence-based
                                        decisions, which route each user prompt to the most suitable T2I model. For example, it selects the most efficient tool (sd-turbo) for “a
                                        photo of a snowboard” while allocating the most justifiable tool (flow-grpo) for “Generate an image containing 5 hamburgers”. (c, d,
                                        e) This intelligent decision-making capability is enabled by our novel (e) self-evolving mechanism, which overcomes the limitations of
                                        previous (c) handcrafted priors or (d) costly supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with human-annotated data.

                                                                    Abstract                                          T2I methods suffer from three key challenges: reliance on
                                                                                                                      expensive handcrafted priors or human annotations, rigid
                                        The explosive growth of Text-to-Image (T2I) models, from                      single-path decision mechanisms, and a neglect of inference
                                        large-scale versions to lightweight, real-time ones, now                      efficiency. To address these challenges, we introduce Oc-
                                        faces diminishing marginal returns from single-model scal-                    toT2I, a novel agentic framework that reformulates the T2I
                                        ing. Agentic T2I methods emerged to alleviate this bottle-                    task as a joint optimization of generation quality and infer-
                                        neck by using multiple models. However, existing agentic                      ence efficiency. OctoT2I implements a stateful, multi-round
                                                                                                                      routing strategy that adaptively selects the most suitable

Figure 2. The overall architecture of OctoT2I. (Top) Inference Workflow. The agent takes a user prompt and executes a “reason-act-
reflect” loop: The decision policy leverages its memory and knowledge modules to select an appropriate tool. This tool is then used to
generate an image, which is subsequently evaluated to obtain a quality score. The workflow terminates when the score meets the quality
threshold or the round limit is reached. (Bottom) Self-Evolving Mechanism. The knowledge module is autonomously and adaptively
constructed from scratch. It includes hierarchical high-level tool profiles and exploration records. This construction is driven by the
“Propose–Solve–Evaluate–Learn” (PSEL) loop, which is guided by the exploration space pruning strategy.

that exhibits strong generalization capabilities.
    Fast Learning and Integration of New Tools. Shown                           This paper introduces OctoT2I, a novel agentic T2I frame-
in Tab. 8, OctoT2I enables efficient, autonomous learning                       work that co-optimizes performance and efficiency, ad-
and seamless integration of new T2I tools—without requir-                       dressing key limitations of prior methods. We present two
ing expert-designed handcrafted priors or costly training on                    core innovations: (1) a self-evolving mechanism enabling
new datasets, as demanded by prior methods [20, 48]. With                       autonomous knowledge acquisition via self-interaction, and
just 60 exploration prompts, it incorporates Flux1.dev, lift-                   (2) a stateful, multi-round agentic router that intelligently
ing performance from 0.54 to 0.61. Adding gpt-image-1                           navigates the generation process using this knowledge. Ex-
further boosts the score to 0.71. This result demonstrates                      periments demonstrate that OctoT2I achieves leading per-
OctoT2I’s exceptional scalability, transforming the tradi-                      formance while significantly reducing inference costs. Our
tionally high-cost, expert-dependent process of tool adap-                      work shows that self-evolving mechanisms and stateful
tation into a fully automated, low-overhead mechanism.                          routing represent a promising direction toward both more
    Robustness to Different LLMs. Tab. 9 demonstrates                           capable and efficient T2I systems. As future work, we plan
the LLM-agnostic robustness of OctoT2I. When the default                        to explore extending this T2I framework to other generative
LLM is replaced with Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B (w/ qwen)                               domains, such as image editing and 3D generation.
